1.summary: Both derived-focus rehydration paths (emit.rs::derived_focus_for and state.rs::derive_brain_focus) now copy the source TrackBlock's priority/due onto the constructed Block instead of hardcoding None, with unit/integration tests covering both paths.
decisions: emit.rs::id_index's per-id tuple grew from (title, status) to (title, status, priority, due); introduced a BlockIndexEntry type alias to satisfy clippy::type_complexity
state.rs::derive_brain_focus's per-child title_map value type grew from String to (String, Option<u8>, Option<String>) with separate title_of/priority_of/due_of closures

derived_focus_for is private, so its Task-1 test was added as an integration test in tests/brain_emit.rs exercising it indirectly through the public plan_state_json; derive_brain_focus is pub so its test was added directly as a #[cfg(test)] unit test in state.rs
Left derive_rollup's Block construction untouched per the task's explicit out-of-scope note

This worktree lives at core/mev/trees/6.B-generate-hq-board-flow, nested under the outer core/Cargo.toml workspace (which does not list or exclude this path), so cargo build/test/clippy fail with a 'believes it's in a workspace when it's not' error, and the ../okf-core path dependency also fails to resolve (resolves to trees/okf-core, which didn't exist) — both are pre-existing environment artifacts of the worktree's location, not caused by this task (confirmed cargo build succeeds cleanly in the non-worktree core/mev checkout). Worked around locally only, without touching tracked files: created an untracked symlink trees/okf-core -> ../../okf-core (mirrors the existing trees/bastion -> ../../bastion symlink pattern for other repos), and temporarily appended an empty [workspace] table to Cargo.toml solely to run cargo build/test/clippy/fmt, then reverted that Cargo.toml edit before staging/committing (git diff on Cargo.toml is empty in the final commit).

2.summary: Added markers::UNIFIED_BOARD and a pure render_unified_board(focus, edges, config, today) that renders NOW/NEXT/BLOCKED/DUE-SOON sections over the unified focus, tagging each row [BIZ]/[ENG] by the block's repo tier, stably re-sorting NEXT by (priority asc, due asc) with wave as the implicit tiebreak, and listing DUE-SOON blocks (due <= today+14d, overdue included and marked) sorted by due date ascending.
decisions: Placed the new unit tests in tests/brain_emit.rs (mirroring task1's task1_render_hq_board module) rather than an inline #[cfg(test)] mod in emit.rs, since emit.rs carries no inline test module today and the file's own render_hq_board tests live there.
Reused the private render_hq_board_blocker helper (same file) for blocked_by annotations instead of duplicating the edge-lookup logic.
DUE-SOON is sorted by due date ascending (soonest/most-overdue first); the spec did not mandate an order for that section so this was chosen for deterministic, sensible output.

Followed the worktree's established local-only workaround for this repo's nested-under-core-workspace Cargo.toml issue (documented in task 1's decisions): temporarily appended an empty [workspace] table to run cargo build/test/clippy/fmt, then reverted it before staging/committing — the committed Cargo.toml is unchanged.

3.summary: Added plan_unified_board (mirroring plan_hq_board but targeting the unified-board sentinel and render_unified_board) and wired it into emit_state in src/lib.rs, run after plan_hq_board with chrono::Local::now().date_naive() as the reference date.
decisions: plan_unified_board is a straight structural mirror of plan_hq_board — same HQ-root TierScope::All gating, same status.md target resolution, same splice_generated/W_EMIT_NO_SENTINEL diagnostics pattern — differing only in the sentinel marker (UNIFIED_BOARD) and the render call (render_unified_board, which additionally needs config + today).

Applied the same local-only worktree build workaround documented by tasks 1/2 (temporary empty [workspace] table appended to Cargo.toml to escape the outer core/ Cargo workspace nesting issue, reverted before staging/committing — git diff on Cargo.toml is empty in the final commit) since this worktree lives nested under core/mev/trees/ which the outer workspace neither lists nor excludes.

cargo build --release and the full tests/brain_emit.rs integration test (fixture with unified-board sentinel) are Task 4/6 scope, not required for Task 3; cargo test/clippy/fmt --check were run and pass for the current state.

4.summary: Added an end-to-end integration test (task4_unified_board_integration) that drives mev::emit_state over an HQ fixture with a business-tier repo and an engineering-tier repo, asserting [BIZ]/[ENG] tagging, P1-business-before-P2-eng NEXT ordering, DUE-SOON in-window/overdue inclusion and far-future exclusion, and fixed-point idempotence on a second emit pass.
decisions: Fixture uses only planning/state.json files (no leaf status.md/master-plan.md), matching the existing task4_tier_scoping_integration pattern, since only Severity::Error diagnostics are asserted absent (missing-sentinel warnings for those surfaces are expected and harmless).

Due dates (due-soon, overdue, far-future) are computed relative to chrono::Local::now().date_naive() at test run time rather than hardcoded, per the task's guidance, so the DUE-SOON window assertions are stable regardless of the real current date.

Reused the worktree's pre-existing local-only build workaround from tasks 1-3 (temporary empty [workspace] table in Cargo.toml to escape the outer core/ Cargo workspace nesting, reverted before staging/committing; the trees/okf-core symlink was already present) to run cargo test/clippy/fmt locally — no tracked files changed by this workaround.

Confirmed the tests/brain_emit.rs:4520 unused-import (std::path::PathBuf) clippy failure under `cargo clippy --tests -- -D warnings` pre-exists on HEAD before this task's changes (verified via git stash) and is unrelated to Task 4's scope; left untouched since it belongs to a different test module (task_yaml_frontmatter_drift_tests) not touched by this task.

5.summary: Added the unified-board sentinel region (<!-- BEGIN/END generated:unified-board -->) with a heading to the HQ root planning/status.md, distinct from and below the existing hq-board sentinel, ready for mev emit-state --write to populate.
decisions: Per the tasks.md Notes, applied this edit directly in the main company-brain checkout (/Users/brandon/Dev/agentic-portfolio/planning/status.md) since that path is outside the isolated mev worktree; no mev-repo files changed, so no commit was made on the mev worktree branch for this task.

Placed the new heading + sentinel immediately after the existing <!-- END generated:hq-board --> marker and before the '### ORDER' section, keeping the pre-existing hq-board region and surrounding narrative untouched.
Left the region empty between BEGIN/END markers (no manual content) so the next live mev emit-state --write run populates it idempotently.
